source_selection_correction_before_freez: 1982 P. jiaochengensis rejected for original long-leaf brief; selected P. sternbergii2021 before concepts. Original inventory unchanged.

source_observations.LOOY2021: Primary text2.3.1,3.2.1 and actual Figure1 fossil pixels plus Figure4A reconstruction inspected. Stem, leaf bases, linear leaf fragments and terminal sporophyll forms; whole-plant arrangement interpreted, not directly preserved complete. The rejected1982 lead concerns short-awn-leaved P. jiaochengensis and was not mixed into this species.
source_observations.NPS-CREVASSE: Deep V-shaped brittle upper-ice cracks above ductile lower ice. Actual paired photo right: Middle Teton crevasses, caption NPS/E.Baker; large irregular fracture and sloping ice, not a checkerboard.
source_observations.NPS-SPATTER: Hot lumps land near central vent and adhere while molten; actual NPS/Jacob W Frank photo shows low irregular welded mound and rough steep upper walls. Paved trail and modern vegetation omitted.
source_observations.NPS-TRAVERTINE: Calcium carbonate deposited after dissolved CO2 releases; actual travertine photo shows thin scalloped cream shelves with shallow flat pools and irregular linked progression. This is not the geyser/silica image.
